PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (16.0, 10.0, 22.0),
    "L_in":    (0.4, 0.25, 1.0),
    "gmid_p":  (9.0, 6.0, 14.0),
    "L_p":     (0.4, 0.2, 1.0),
    "gmid_t":  (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),
    "L_t":     (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),
    "Itail":   (55e-6, 20e-6, 65e-6),
    "R1":      (200e3, 60e3, 1e6),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 0.2e-12)
    g_target = 0.007                         # |a1| centre
    pmax = 140e-6
    # ---- current budget (IREF counted in power) ----
    itail = min(p["Itail"], 0.95 * pmax / vdd - iref)
    itail = max(itail, 5e-6)
    ih = itail / 2

    # ---- devices ----
    vtail = 0.25                              # estimated tail node
    vout_dc = 0.9
    m_in = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], ih, vds=vout_dc - vtail, vsb=vtail)
    m_ld = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], ih, vds=0.85)
    m_t = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], p["L_t"], itail, vds=vtail)
    m_bd = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], p["L_t"], iref, vds=0.7)
    m_bd = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], p["L_t"], iref, vds=m_bd.vgs)

    # ---- feedback network with finite-gain pre-compensation ----
    R1 = p["R1"]
    rf0 = g_target * R1
    gL = 1.0 / (R1 + rf0)
    A = m_in.gm / (m_in.gds + m_ld.gds + gL)
    ratio = g_target
    for _ in range(5):
        beta = 1.0 / (1.0 + ratio)
        # a1 = -ratio / (1 + 1/(A*beta))  -> solve ratio for |a1| = g_target
        ratio = g_target * (1.0 + 1.0 / (A * beta))
    Rf = ratio * R1
    beta = 1.0 / (1.0 + ratio)

    n = Netlist("vin1 vin2 vout vcm vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m_bd)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m_t)
    # diff pair: M1 (gate vcm) on diode side, M2 (gate vx = inverting) on output side
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vcm", "tail", "vss", m_in)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vx", "tail", "vss", m_in)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m_ld)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m_ld)
    # feedback
    n.R("R1", "vin1", "vx", R1)
    n.R("RF", "vx", "vout", Rf)
    n.R("R2", "vin2", "vcm", 1e6)            # vin2 unused, terminated

    # ---- predictions ----
    a1 = -ratio / (1.0 + 1.0 / (A * beta))
    cout = cl + m_in.cdd + m_ld.cdd + m_in.cgd + m_ld.cgd
    f_u = m_in.gm / (2 * PI * cout)
    p_vx = 1.0 / (2 * PI * (Rf * R1 / (Rf + R1)) * (m_in.cgg + 1e-15))
    p_mir = m_ld.gm / (2 * PI * (2 * m_ld.cgg + m_in.cdd + m_ld.cdd))
    bw = beta * f_u
    bw = 1.0 / math.sqrt(1.0 / bw**2 + 0.5 / p_vx**2 + 0.25 / p_mir**2)
    # systematic offset: mirror Vds mismatch (diode ~|Vgs_p| vs 0.9 V output)
    dv = (vdd - m_ld.vgs) - vout_dc
    vos = (m_ld.gds * dv) / m_in.gm
    power = vdd * (iref + itail)
    return n, {"a1": a1, "a2": 0.0, "bw": bw, "vout_offset": vos / beta,
               "power": power, "loop_gain_db": db(A * beta)}
